experimental_unit: The same 15 nonrandom GBIF source pages and exactly the same 1,500 historical occurrence records as preceding field-presence stage

predeclared_codebook.normalization: NFC, whitespace collapse, casefold uppercase; exact official DOF code strings only; no substring/fuzzy code interpretation

interpretation.what_failed: None of the 1,500 GBIF behavior strings matched the 31 exact original published DOF primary/secondary behavior codes and primary names. This is a vocabulary/serialization crosswalk failure, NOT verification of zero breeding.
interpretation.what_was_independently_grounded: GBIF species and source data were previously confirmed; numeric uncertainty and original behavior field presence reproduced in v3; source official codebook exists but does not specify how those codes are exported through this GBIF field.
interpretation.why_not_repair: Any new normalization or additional behavior labels after inspecting results must use a new documented source mapping and separate post-exposure diagnostic, cannot retrofit preregistered v3.
interpretation.needed_external_evidence: GBIF indexed behavior field transformation / publisher occurrence DwC-A behavior value vocabulary and original DOF coding dictionary/version mapping, plus breeding pair/nest fields, exact locality and uncertainty, historical record entry chronology.
no_claims: 115 original tern alternative source colonies independently verified
prospective MRR prediction or causal source mechanism
